name: Plan → build → review
description: 3 slots, roles set, handoff order on

slots.prompt: Read the issue, write PLAN.md with numbered steps, then stop.
Wait for the planner's brief. Implement step by step; one commit per step.
Review the builder's diff. Comments only; end with approve / changes requested.

shared: Work only inside your worktree. Keep tests green. Finish by summarising what changed in 3 lines.
